# Displacement map

Offsets the image by the values of a texture, scaled and scrolling: red and green move pixels sideways and up, or brightness moves them along an angle. Without a map it uses animated simplex noise.

<EffectDemo effect="displacement-map" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { displacementMap } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/displacement-map';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(displacementMap({ preset: 'heatHaze' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.map = 'noise'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                             | Default        | Range        | Description                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | -------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `map`      | 2D texture or 'noise' \| 'waves' | `'noise'`      |              | Displacement texture, centered on 0.5 (mid-gray moves nothing). With no map, procedural simplex noise is used. |
| `strength` | number                           | `0.03`         | 0 – 0.25     | Largest offset, as a fraction of the height.                                                                   |
| `scale`    | number                           | `1`            | 0.1 – 8      | Map repeats across the height of the image.                                                                    |
| `scroll`   | [x, y]                           | `[0.02, 0.01]` | -1 – 1       | Map movement per second, in map widths.                                                                        |
| `channel`  | 'rg' \| 'luminance'              | `'rg'`         |              | Red and green move pixels horizontally and vertically, or brightness moves them along the angle.               |
| `angle`    | number                           | `45`           | -180 – 180 ° | Luminance: direction of the offset.                                                                            |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                                                           |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `heatHaze` | `map: 'noise'`, `strength: 0.008`, `scale: 3`, `scroll: [0, 0.12]`                 |
| `glass`    | `map: 'waves'`, `strength: 0.02`, `scale: 1.5`, `scroll: [0, 0]`                   |
| `liquid`   | `map: null`, `strength: 0.05`, `scale: 2`, `scroll: [0.05, 0.03]`                  |
| `smear`    | `map: 'noise'`, `channel: 'luminance'`, `strength: 0.06`, `angle: 0`, `scale: 0.6` |

Apply one with `displacementMap({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 6.7 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/displacement-map`, including the shared effect runtime.
